svg.aria-label: A two-by-two grid: how much rests on a decision against how far the context has moved since it was confirmed. Little resting, little movement: leave it. Much resting, little movement: record and watch. Little resting, much movement: reconsider it now. Much resting, much movement: revisit with today's validators and fence before rebuilding.
svg.text: What to do with a decision, by weight and drift
Reconsider it now
The context has moved and little depends
on it yet. If the evidence supports a change,
this is likely the easiest time to make it.
Revisit with today's validators
Much rests on it and the people who
confirmed it no longer represent who
we serve. Fence it before rebuilding it.
Uber's card-only payments in India
Leave it
A two-way door. Change it when there
is a reason; a light process is enough.
Record it and watch
Write down who confirmed it and in what
context. Look again when the market, the
customer or the regulator changes.
S3's interface; Stripe's developer-first core
How much rests on it →
How far the context has moved →
A judgement aid, not a scoring model: weight and drift are assessed from the six questions, not calculated.
